prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1217; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured vehicle reportedly backed into a parked sedan while exiting a space. Claimant reports a knee injury and has retained counsel, who has requested that all communication be routed through their office.

Entry 2: Acknowledgment letter sent to claimant's attorney confirming receipt of the claim and requesting the medical records and treatment history for the claimed knee injury. Insured's statement obtained; insured states the other vehicle was stationary and the impact was minor.

Entry 3: Photos of both vehicles received from the insured and claimant's counsel. Damage to the rear bumper of the insured vehicle and the front quarter panel of the claimant vehicle is consistent with the reported loss. Parking lot surveillance footage requested from the property owner.

Entry 4: Attorney's office responded with a demand package including an orthopedic evaluation of the knee injury, physical therapy notes, and ongoing treatment plan. Reviewing records for causation and consistency with the reported mechanism of impact. Referred file to medical review.

Entry 5: Medical review completed. Treatment appears reasonable for the reported knee injury, though prior imaging is being requested to assess pre-existing conditions. Counsel notified that evaluation of the injury claim is pending receipt of the outstanding records and that a settlement position will follow once review is complete.
